title: Pragmatic study on refusals performed by Israeli native Hebrew speakers and Egyptian Hebrew-as-a-second-language learners
core_idea: To investigate how Egyptian learners of Hebrew (HSL) produce refusal strategies compared with Israeli native Hebrew speakers, using Beebe et al.'s refusal taxonomy and a discourse completion task featuring five social situations in Hebrew to analyze semantic formulas of refusal.
tldr: Compare production of refusal speech acts by Egyptian HSL learners and Israeli native speakers via a DCT and Beebe refusal taxonomy to examine semantic refusal formulas across five scenarios.
